description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
# 25.4.1 [Alpha]
Holy shit i'm back y'all~

## Improvements
- Fix for game hanging on level save on bigger levels.
- Improvements to level creation code to fix some weird edge cases.
- Improvements to quit code to disallow quitting while a level is saving in editor.

## Bug Fixes
- Fix for preview / editor switching not maintaining / resetting speed settings properly.
- Fix for player collision being inconsistent in some cases. (now all collision issues should be fixed)

# [Alpha] -> [Default]
Expect this build to be on default by end of the day tomorrow assuming no major issues found. (Probably for real this time?)
